name: 11eyes -Resona Forma-
source:
This is a fandisk for 2008 release 11eyes that includes a before, after and ‘if’ story, with particular emphasis on Lizelotte. There is a mix of both serious and light romance stories. The cross vision system makes a return. There are also some user-written short stories included.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是2008年作品《11eyes》的Fan Disc，收录前传、后日谈与‘假如’故事，尤其着重描写莉泽洛特。内容兼有严肃剧情与轻松恋爱故事，Cross Vision系统也再度回归。此外，游戏还收录了一些由用户创作的短篇故事。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
